paired_reference: Every non-truthful cell is compared to the exact truthful counterpart with identical pair, adapter, shock, seed, allocation policy and focal obligation.
mechanism_findings: Criticality-priority is manipulable by criticality inflation: 63.3333% of comparable focal outcomes improve, mean gain 4.1 ticks, maximum 14 ticks.
Minimum-liquidity-demand is manipulable by liquidity-demand underreporting: 36.6667% of comparable focal outcomes improve, mean gain 1.8733333 ticks, maximum 9 ticks.
FIFO is insensitive to these declarations in the declared model because it does not consume them for ordering.
externality_finding: The focal advantage can delay non-focal obligations: mean other-obligation completion externality is +0.7818182 ticks for criticality-priority manipulation and +1.5818182 ticks for minimum-liquidity-demand manipulation.
resource_integrity: All reservations consume immutable true liquidity demand; peak concurrent reservation stayed within capacity in all 12,960 cells.
design_implication: Claims used as allocation inputs require an explicit authority/truth layer, cost for misreporting, verification, bounded influence, or another mechanism-design safeguard; otherwise the synthetic mechanism can reward assertion rather than the underlying fact.
claim_ceiling: Synthetic deterministic mechanism-design observation only; this does not establish empirical strategic behavior, equilibrium, incentive compatibility, truthfulness, welfare superiority, or real-system safety.
